faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIT BHU is 11th September 2026. Ensure all your details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree (M.E./M.Tech/MS.) in Metallurgy/Chemical Engineering/Material Science/Mechanical Engineering with a First Division at both graduate and postgraduate levels, along with five years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for the IIT BHU Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without any financial obligation towards the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 32 years. However, age relaxation is provided for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations available for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available. Candidates from Female/SC/ST/PH categories can avail 5 years of relaxation, and OBC candidates can avail 3 years of relaxation. Exceptional candidates may also be considered for relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position at IIT BHU primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIT BHU is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions specified in the offer letter.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIT BHU Research Associate recruitment must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be considered for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, at the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi campus.
